summary: SFL Corporation Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing that Norway's Borgarting Court of Appeal ruled unanimously that Seadrill subsidiaries breached a drilling contract upon redelivery of the rig Hercules to SFL's rig-owning subsidiary in December 2022. The court awarded SFL's subsidiary approximately NOK 525 million (about $55 million), covering compensation, late-payment interest, and legal costs, largely upholding the February 2025 Oslo District Court ruling with interest accretion. SFL recovered full legal costs across both instances. Either party may appeal to Norway's Supreme Court within one month; leave is rarely granted. Watch for appeal risk to the award.
